Package com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl

Class MemberRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl.MemberRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGeneralRepository<Member,Integer>, IMemberRepository
public class MemberRepositoryImpl extends Object implements IMemberRepository
JDBC implementation of the IMemberRepository interface using JdbcTemplateLight.

This repository manages Member entities with support for unique document ID validation, status management, and member search capabilities.

Key Features:

  • Document ID and email uniqueness validation
  • Member status management (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, SUSPENDED)
  • Full-text search by name
  • Active members filtering for loan eligibility
  • Simplified database operations with JdbcTemplateLight
